page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.u2a-c1m4.6xlarge is a general-purpose virtual instance hosted on the KVM hypervisor. The hardware profile is driven by an x86_64 AMD EPYC processor clocked at 2.25 GHz, provisioning 24 dedicated vCPUs. Memory is allocated at 96 GB, establishing a standard 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio with 4 GB of memory per core.

The instance does not include integrated local disk storage, requiring deployment alongside network-attached block storage for operating system persistence and application state. Additionally, this server type operates without GPU accelerators and provides no complimentary public IPv4 addresses. Network performance is provisioned with a baseline network bandwidth of 7 Gbps to handle internal and external traffic demands.

Given its dedicated core allocation and balanced core-to-memory density, the ecs.u2a-c1m4.6xlarge delivers consistent compute capability for non-accelerated business environments. It is aligned with general-purpose enterprise tasks, including container orchestration nodes, middle-tier application servers, relational database replicas, and continuous integration runners.

The server type does not feature discrete GPU accelerators or bundled local disk storage, relying on network-attached storage solutions for all persistent data needs. Providing steady multi-core execution across a dedicated AMD resource pool, ecs.u2a-c1m4.6xlarge is tailored for workloads requiring predictable performance and moderate memory footprints, including web application servers, microservices clusters, enterprise middle-tier backends, and distributed compilation systems.
